entities.name: Calvin
entities.description: A rapper and musician, and one of the two speakers. Over 2023 he moved into a mansion in Japan, bought a red Ferrari and later a second, black one, toured with Frank Ocean, released an album on 11 September 2023, converted part of his mansion into a recording studio, and repeatedly planned and made trips to Boston to see his friend Dave.

entities.name: Dave
entities.description: A car mechanic and self-described automotive engineer in Boston, and the other speaker. He opened his own car maintenance shop in May 2023, restores classic cars, joined a rock band in June 2023, started a car-modification blog in late 2023 and took up photography in October 2023. He has been fascinated by machines since he was ten and learned to work on cars with his father.

entities.name: Frank Ocean
entities.description: The well-known artist Calvin toured with through 2023. Calvin met him at a music festival in Tokyo, said in October 2023 that the meeting was in August the previous year, recorded a song with him in the studio at his Japanese mansion, and secured a deal in August 2023 to continue the collaboration.

entities.name: Dave's father
entities.description: Dave's father, who took him to his first car show when Dave was ten and worked on cars with him throughout his childhood, including one summer spent restoring an old car together. Dave traces his career in car repair back to the hours he spent in his father's garage.

entities.name: Calvin's father
entities.description: Calvin's father, who took him on a childhood road trip during which they sang along to California Love by Tupac and Dr. Dre — a memory Calvin recalled on 22 September 2023 as one that still makes him smile.

entities.name: Calvin's high school friend
entities.description: An old friend of Calvin's from high school, with whom he used to freestyle as a teenager and talk about getting famous. Calvin visited Boston sights with him on 24 October 2023 and invited him to a Boston performance in November 2023; Calvin credits his constant support and positivity.

properties.aliases: my high school friend; my old high school buddy

entities.name: Tupac
entities.description: One of the two artists behind California Love, the song from Calvin's childhood road trips with his father.

entities.name: Dr. Dre
entities.description: One of the two artists behind California Love, the song Calvin named on 22 September 2023 as a favourite from his childhood.

entities.name: Japan
entities.description: The country Calvin moved to in 2023. He had never been there before March 2023, was fascinated by its traditions, took a mansion there, collaborated with Japanese artists and had a guitar custom-made by a Japanese artist friend. Dave has never visited but wants to.

entities.name: Tokyo
entities.description: The Japanese city where Calvin attended a music festival in April 2023, met Frank Ocean, performed to a crowd that sang along, and photographed the skyline at night on 15 May 2023. Dave has never been and repeatedly said he wants to go.

entities.name: Boston
entities.description: Dave's home city, where his car maintenance shop is and where he goes to music festivals, rock concerts and parks. Calvin planned a Boston visit from March 2023 onwards, booked a flight in late August 2023, met local artists there on 3 October 2023, went sightseeing with his high school friend on 24 October 2023 and attended a gala there on 16 November 2023. Dave named Paradise Rock, House of Blues and Fenway Park as its music venues.

entities.name: Miami
entities.description: The city whose beach Calvin picked for the music video for his new album, shot from the weekend before 31 August 2023.

entities.name: San Francisco
entities.description: The city where Dave attended a car restoration and modification workshop in August 2023, returning from a further visit on 1 September 2023 with new knowledge of car modification.

entities.name: Detroit
entities.description: The city where Dave attended a conference shortly before 25 October 2023 and said he learned a lot.

entities.name: Shibuya Crossing
entities.description: The Tokyo intersection Calvin compared to Times Square and named on 19 October 2023 as a place he was excited to see on his November 2023 return to Tokyo.

entities.name: Shinjuku
entities.description: A Tokyo district Calvin said on 19 October 2023 he was excited to explore on his return to the city.

entities.name: Calvin's Japanese mansion
entities.description: The mansion in Japan Calvin acquired in March 2023 through his agent, with a city-skyline view he calls a dream come true. He converted part of it into a recording studio, recorded a song there with Frank Ocean, keeps a separate TV room for relaxing, and threw a party there for his new album in the week before 2 November 2023.

entities.name: Dave's car maintenance shop
entities.description: The car maintenance shop Dave opened in Boston, announced on 1 May 2023 and celebrated with friends in mid-May. It handles everything from routine maintenance to full classic-car restorations. In October 2023 a competing shop won a deal Dave's shop had chased for months, which left him discouraged.

entities.name: Dave's rock band
entities.description: The rock band Dave joined around June 2023, having been a fan of it for years. He plays guitar; the band jammed on 14 September 2023 without recording it, and had a guitar-themed logo made by November 2023.

entities.name: Aerosmith
entities.description: The band Dave named as his favourite act at the Boston music festival he attended before 26 March 2023, and the first act he had seen live. Calvin said he likes them too.

entities.name: The Fireworks
entities.description: The band that headlined the music festival Dave returned from shortly before 15 October 2023.

entities.name: the car modification workshop
entities.description: The car modification and restoration workshop Dave was selected for in August 2023 and attended in San Francisco. He called it a dream come true, did engine swaps and suspension work there and went on to learn body modification.

entities.name: Calvin's album
entities.description: The album Calvin worked on with a creative team through 2023, met them about on 8 June 2023, released on 11 September 2023 to a response he found overwhelming, shot a Miami beach music video for, and celebrated with a party at his Japanese mansion in late October 2023.

entities.name: Ratatouille
entities.description: The Disney film Calvin named on 15 September 2023 as one of his favourites, for its message about going after what you love regardless of what others say. Dave said the same film is one of his favourite Disney movies.

entities.name: California Love
entities.description: The Tupac and Dr. Dre song Calvin and his father sang along to on a childhood road trip; Calvin named it on 22 September 2023 as the song that always makes him smile, and Dave called it a classic.

entities.name: Dave's car modification blog
entities.description: The blog about car modifications Dave started shortly before 2 November 2023 to share his passion. Readers ask him for advice, and a post about making a car look like a beast prompted others to start their own DIY projects.

entities.name: Calvin's red Ferrari
entities.description: The red luxury sports car Calvin bought in March 2023, his first, which he drove on 25 March 2023 and treats as a symbol of his hard work. Long drives in it relax him. It was damaged in an accident on 16 June 2023, repaired within weeks and back on the road by 7 July 2023, and serviced shortly before 3 August 2023.

entities.name: Calvin's black Ferrari
entities.description: A second Ferrari, black, which Calvin said on 15 October 2023 he had bought in the previous week and called a masterpiece on wheels. Distinct from the red Ferrari he has owned since March 2023.

entities.name: Calvin's octopus guitar
entities.description: A guitar custom-made for Calvin by a Japanese artist friend, painted with an octopus to represent his love of art and the sea and finished in a shiny purple. One of his favourites, which he says reminds him of his passion for music and the friendships he has made.

entities.name: the vintage Ford Mustang
entities.description: A Ford Mustang Dave found in a junkyard in bad shape and restored through 2023. Its engine still made a strange noise on 22 September 2023 after he thought he had fixed it; he reported the restoration finished on 29 October 2023.

entities.name: Calvin's diamond pendant necklace
entities.description: A gold necklace with a diamond pendant given to Calvin by another artist. He showed it on 1 May 2023 and said it reminds him why he keeps working as a musician.

entities.name: Dave's vintage camera
entities.description: The vintage camera Dave bought in November 2023 and uses for his photography; he says it captures special moments very clearly.

entities.name: restoring and fixing up cars
entities.description: Dave's lifelong practice and now his living: restoring classic cars, engine swaps, suspension and body modifications, and fixing neighbours' cars. He calls it therapy and a sense of purpose. Calvin said in May 2023 that working on cars calms him too, like meditating.

entities.name: photography
entities.description: The hobby Dave took up in October 2023. He photographs Boston sunsets and the clock tower, and nature — sunsets, beaches, waves and a waterfall in a nearby park — and bought a vintage camera for it in November 2023. He calls it a creative outlet.

entities.name: walking in parks
entities.description: Dave's way of relaxing: weekend walks and strolls in Boston's parks, which he says recharge him for the week. By July 2023 he had arranged regular walks in the park with friends. He recommended one park to Calvin in March 2023, and Calvin visited it in October 2023.

entities.name: Calvin's tour with Frank Ocean
entities.description: The tour Calvin performed on with Frank Ocean through 2023, including a Tokyo date in late May 2023 and a planned Boston leg. Calvin described the tour as ending around late August 2023 and then as starting again in October 2023, and planned to return to Tokyo once it ended.

entities.name: the recording studio in Calvin's Japanese mansion
entities.description: Calvin's project, reported in progress on 21 July 2023, to transform part of his Japanese mansion into a recording studio — a sanctuary for making music with other artists. He recorded a song there with Frank Ocean.

entities.name: Dave's Mustang restoration
entities.description: Dave's restoration of the vintage Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard. He hoped to finish by the end of September 2023, hit an engine problem on 22 September 2023, and reported it finished on 29 October 2023.

entities.name: the music video for Calvin's album
entities.description: The music video Calvin began shooting on a Miami beach on the weekend before 31 August 2023, planned around epic visuals. Dave offered to help with props.
